evidence.title: US Government designates host of noblogs.org a "global terrorist"

summary: The United States has officially designated the company that provides hosting for the site noblogs.org as a global terrorist organization, citing alleged links to extremist activity. The unprecedented move could trigger sanctions, disrupt the site’s operations, and set a new precedent for targeting internet infrastructure.
title: US Government Labels Noblogs.org Host as Global Terrorist
